# Daily Report — 2026-10-08

## Task Completed
Add `list_problem_task_comments` tool — journal entries (comments and work notes) for problem tasks.

Queries the `sys_journal_field` table scoped to `name=problem_task` and the task's `element_id`.
Accepts a PTASK number (e.g. PTASK0010001) or a 32-char sys_id via `_resolve_problem_task_sys_id`.
Optional `entry_type` filter (`comments` / `work_notes`). Pagination with `has_more` / `next_offset`.
Response includes `comments` list (sys_id, type, value, created_on, created_by), `count`, `task_id`, and `message`.
Registered in `service_desk`, `change_coordinator`, and `full` packages.
